description.value:
Your knowledge of your craft deepens. You learn two additional Witchcraft options. Additionally, you can select two Witchcraft options you know, which improve as described below:

Amelioration. You can also use this feature on targets with the Confused, Dazed, Exhausted, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, and Stunned conditions.

Cackle. You affect all creatures of your choice that can hear you within 60 feet.

Evil Eye. You can use this feature as an Action or Bonus Action, but only once per turn.

Familiar Focus. As an Action, you can switch positions with your bonded familiar if you can see it.

Kettle Chant. The bonus to the listed crafting checks is now equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Mind Fog. If the target fails the Concentration Saving Throw, it takes psychic damage equal to half your Witch level + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Minor Prophecy. You gain 1 additional use of this feature. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Witch Spittle. The healing from this feature is doubled.
